summary: Steep residential kerb, homes 11-20 m away, No Parking Any Time signs.
reasons: Dwellings 11-20 m away on both sides
No Parking Any Time signs both ends

drivers.seclusion: Homes sit 11-20 m from the kerb all along; no stretch is clear of dwellings.
drivers.access_and_room: Narrow sealed street with kerb-to-fence verge and trees; little room to pull off.
drivers.convention: Two No Parking Any Time signs about 10 m off the line; some cars park but no campervans seen.
